stem.text: Two loudspeakers X and Y emit sound waves that are in phase and of wavelength $0.75\,\text{m}$.
An observer O is able to stand anywhere on a straight line that passes through X and Y, as shown. The observer stands at a point where the sound waves from X and Y meet in phase.

stem.alt: Diagram of an observer labelled O standing on a dashed line, with two loudspeakers labelled X and Y on the same line.
